definition: The mechanism can act only inside the evidenced window of this axis (for the stated matrix scope).
straddles_or_bound_not_reported: UNKNOWN (value or interval straddles a bound, or the bound on the relevant side is NOT_REPORTED)
input_missing_or_unaudited: UNKNOWN (no value, no interval, condition_trust UNAUDITED while the Step-07 gate has not passed (R-05), or the gate status is not ACCEPTED)
annotation: A NECESSARY gate (or a precondition) is required before gates_unknown may be false. Rule E-7 (ontology 4.3; OPEN_QUESTION D21-20): for a CHEMICAL_REACTION a NECESSARY gate on a temperature, pH or water-activity axis is admitted only when PRIMARY evidence states that the reaction is absent (not merely slow) and the gate says so; otherwise the axis is MODULATING and an UNKNOWN input blocks SIMULATE at G7. Bounds are applicability limits and never FORM / PARAM inputs (L-21-7).
source: plan Step 23-M 'Axis gate' (L922); Audit J1.1.4 (L10426-10440); Rosso et al. 1995 cardinal values via r_mechanism_registry F5.1

definition: The axis changes direction, selectivity or rate of the mechanism but never decides whether it can act.
value_inside_window: no change to the verdict (annotation only)
value_outside_window: no change to the verdict (annotation only)
input_missing_or_unaudited: no change to the verdict; the annotation is simply absent
annotation: qualifies the direction or selectivity of affected_targets; the modulates field says which aspect (RATE, SELECTIVITY, DIRECTION). A MODULATING gate alone never lets gates_unknown be false (no vacuous APPLICABLE). It is also the gate type of the axis of a CATALYST or PROMOTER modifier (never changes the verdict; the axis is still a required condition axis for Step 22 / G7).
source: plan Step 23-M ('A MODULATING axis never changes the verdict'); Audit J1.1.4

definition: Inside the window of this axis (or when the listed category is present) the mechanism is blocked.
value_inside_window: NOT_APPLICABLE when the inhibitor's extent is COMPLETE; downgrade (Step 23 owns the rule) when PARTIAL; UNKNOWN when extent is UNKNOWN (proposed reading)
annotation: An INHIBITING gate alone never lets gates_unknown be false: absence of an inhibitor is not a positive condition. Used by an INHIBITOR / MITIGATOR modifier in GATE mode.
source: plan Step 23-M (INHIBITING agent or condition present => NOT_APPLICABLE, or downgrade to QUALITATIVE if partial; absent => APPLICABLE; UNKNOWN => UNKNOWN); r_mechanism_registry F5.4(iii)
